name: JMIT Sales Dashboard API
script:
# Inspect Stock Ledger Entries and Stock Balance with bin locations

# 1. Stock Balance from tabBin + Bin Location references from Purchase Receipt / Stock Entry
bins_raw = frappe.db.sql('''
    SELECT
        b.item_code,
        item.item_name,
        b.warehouse,
        b.actual_qty,
        b.valuation_rate,
        b.stock_value,
        item.item_group
    FROM `tabBin` b
    INNER JOIN `tabItem` item ON item.name = b.item_code
    WHERE b.actual_qty != 0
    ORDER BY b.actual_qty DESC
    LIMIT 50
''', as_dict=True) or []

# 2. Stock Ledger Entries
sle_raw = frappe.db.sql('''
    SELECT
        sle.posting_date,
        sle.posting_time,
        sle.voucher_type,
        sle.voucher_no,
        sle.item_code,
        item.item_name,
        sle.warehouse,
        sle.actual_qty,
        sle.qty_after_transaction,
        sle.stock_value,
        sle.company
    FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
    INNER JOIN `tabItem` item ON item.name = sle.item_code
    ORDER BY sle.posting_date DESC, sle.posting_time DESC, sle.name DESC
    LIMIT 50
''', as_dict=True) or []

# 3. Bin locations from Purchase Receipts / Stock Entries
pri_bins = frappe.db.sql('''
    SELECT
        parent AS voucher_no,
        item_code,
        warehouse,
        storage_bin,
        shelf_location,
        rack_location
    FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item`
    WHERE storage_bin IS NOT NULL OR shelf_location IS NOT NULL OR rack_location IS NOT NULL
    LIMIT 50
''', as_dict=True) or []

frappe.response["type"] = "json"
frappe.response["message"] = {
    "bins_count": len(bins_raw),
    "sample_bin": bins_raw[:3],
    "sle_count": len(sle_raw),
    "sample_sle": sle_raw[:3],
    "pri_bins": pri_bins[:3]
}
